entries.name: Settings
entries.notes: Branch feature/wireframe-settings. Rail (wide) or selector above the pane (compact) is chosen by SettingsWorkspaceModel from wireframeUi.settings; no pane heading; header is title + exit only; help hidden on seven self-evident rows; condition, status, applied lines and persistence unchanged. Browser-measured at 1440x860, 1280x800 (rail) and 390x844, 375x667, 844x390 (selector) with emulation only; verification states stay pending until the owner reviews. Changelog and About remain in the rail; Display is labelled Display (was Game).

entries.name: Compendium
entries.notes: mountCompendium is a W1 page door (w1-workspace): title Compendium with the held count as eyebrow and exit; armament kinds on the rail (a [Kind ▾] selector above the pane on compact hosts); the pane splits the entry list from the selected entry's known facts; one Back fills the footer. CompendiumModel projects sections, selection and entryDetail, which withholds name (unless listed), mods and tags exactly as the tooltip does. Frame shares in wireframeUi.workspace. Hooks .cp-cell/.cp-grid/.cp-scroll/#cp-back kept. Galaxy S24 not measured.

entries.name: Profile
entries.notes: openProfileArchive is a W1 workspace door: rail categories are the two drawer kinds save.js writes (set-aside profiles, set-aside runs), a [Kind ▾] selector on compact hosts; the pane shows current profile identity beside the selected category's records with their export/restore actions and status; one Back fills the footer. ProfileWorkspaceModel projects categories, counts and empty states. Owner decision open: the gallery example's Overview/History/Discoveries/Progression categories were not bound (those live on other routes). Galaxy S24 not measured.

entries.name: Discard / Exhaust viewer
entries.notes: openSpentPileModal on the W1 rail (kit railed/rail/railItem): Discard and Exhaust are rail categories (above the pane on compact hosts), never head tabs; the pane shows the pile beside the selected card reading (cardDetailHtml, the inspect door body); single Close footer. PileViewerModel.spentPileView projects labels, counts, empty state and the reading. Rail items keep role=tab, aria-selected and data-modal-tab.

The menu passes its Use row and rings onAction('use') only when the door's Use is pressed. Capacity is not shown: flask definitions carry none.

entries.name: Buttons and inspection
entries.notes: Appearance roles resolved by ControlAppearance.js with contract precedence. The nine size presets (third/half/full × standard/tall/double) live in wireframeUi.buttons and resolve through ButtonSizeModel.js; the kit writes their tokens onto :root. Consumers: every modalFooter (equal shares after gaps, a sole action fills the foot) and the game-over choice row (half preset capped by the equal share, labels wrap). Header exits, steppers, inspect, map nodes, status icons and the packed combat footer keep their own geometry. Other button rows still use the short/medium/long/fill ladder.

entries.name: Inspect control
entries.notes: InspectControlModel.js with wireframeUi.inspect (sizeRem 2.75, labelPx 16, gapPx 10). main.js writes --inspect-size / --inspect-label / --inspect-gap; card, equipment card, combatant and hand-portal controls all read them (one 44 physical px circle, 16 px label, 10 px above the owner; combatant control above the intent). The reveal delay is selection.revealDelayMs. Only the creation corner still declares its own --card-info-size.

entries.name: Context action
entries.notes: Choice groups use kit choiceRow(): siblings share one WCB0 preset (half by default) capped by the equal share after gaps. The game-over door is the first consumer; modal footers use equal shares. The selected-card full-width Use action is not migrated.

entries.name: Primary / confirmation button
entries.notes: Primary role: green when ready, stronger when highlighted; destructive never green; End Turn uses the registered combatEndTurn exception.

entries.name: Back / cancel button
entries.notes: Back/Close/Cancel/Leave carry the exit role: brown/gold at rest, red while highlighted; a sole exit in the primary slot is not green.

entries.name: Exit button
entries.notes: Header exit carries the exit role; its face turns red under pointer, keyboard, or pad highlight. Square geometry from --iconbtn-size.

entries.name: Component foundations
entries.notes: Foundations: ComponentModel.js (immutable, serializable, validated records) plus the WCF3 selection effect from wireframeUi.selection via SelectionEffectModel.js.

entries.name: Component contract
entries.notes: componentModel() validates the registered id, serializable properties/tokens/accessibility, Behavior Models and child Component Models, and freezes the record; owner selection is the only selected state (cards: cardSelection store; combatants: context-selected).

entries.name: Ordered active stack
entries.notes: Ordered active stack from CombatantStackModel: HP, resources, buildup by fill, stance, icons; max five rows; excess buildup becomes ring pips.

entries.name: Selection effect
entries.notes: One shared glow, selectionGlowFilter() = drop-shadow(0 0 0.35rem var(--gold)), written once to :root as --selection-glow. It is applied to the whole owner: a selected card (its inspect control is a child; the hand portal wears the same filter) and a selected combatant's whole stack (intent, inspect, art, name, lower stack). Per-child outlines and glow shadows removed. Reveal delay has one home, selection.revealDelayMs (1000 ms), read by card inspection, equipment cards and combatant inspection.

entries.name: Inspector facts
entries.notes: Inspector facts render as uniform label/value rows from CombatantInspectorSections; empty states say None. or Unknown.

entries.name: Identity and artwork
entries.notes: IdentityModel.js (IDENTITY_PARTS name/artwork/metadata) with wireframeUi.identity. Cards, combatants and the inspector preview stamp data-identity-part on the parts they own; values stay with the owner.

entries.name: Nameplate
entries.notes: Card header, combatant nameplate and inspector title carry data-identity-part=name. The combatant nameplate is the card child directly above the meters (HP first).

entries.name: Sprite / artwork
entries.notes: artworkAnchor(host): card and inspector centre, combatant bottom (baseline); artwork keeps its intrinsic ratio (object-fit contain). Facing mirrors only the .facing art layer, never text or controls.

entries.name: Metadata footer
entries.notes: metadataFooter: rarity at the start, Owned: n at the end (wireframeUi.identity.metadataSlots); an unstated fact is absent. Reward, shop and draft offers pass the deck count; deck and pile views omit it. Equipment cards keep their own footer (WC2).
